description: Search PSA population reports, fetch a full set census, or look up specific spec numbers.

category.description: Limit search results and label records with the collectible category. Choose All to search every category.
category.title: Collectible category

headingIds.description: Numeric PSA set IDs from a population URL's last path segment. Use when you already store set IDs.
headingIds.title: Set heading IDs

includeSetTotal.description: Emit one extra row with the set-wide grade census (mode=setPopulation).
includeSetTotal.title: Include set total

isPsaDna.description: Use the PSA/DNA certified population line instead of the standard card population.
isPsaDna.title: PSA/DNA certified tab

maxEnrichSets.description: Maximum matching sets to fetch when keyword results need population counts (mode=searchCards).
maxEnrichSets.title: Maximum sets to enrich

maxGrade10.description: Keep cards with at most this many PSA 10 copies.
maxGrade10.title: Maximum PSA 10 population

maxSearchPages.description: Maximum keyword-search pages to walk when matching sets need population enrichment.
maxSearchPages.title: Maximum search pages

maxSetPages.description: Maximum 500-card pages to walk per set when resolving spec numbers.
maxSetPages.title: Maximum set pages for spec lookup

maxTotal.description: Keep cards with at most this many graded copies.
maxTotal.title: Maximum total graded

minGrade10.description: Keep cards with at least this many PSA 10 copies.
minGrade10.title: Minimum PSA 10 population

minTotal.description: Keep cards with at least this many graded copies.
minTotal.title: Minimum total graded

mode.description: Search cards by keyword, fetch a full set population report, or look up specific spec numbers.
mode.title: What to look up

query.description: Player, card, set or year to search, for example "1952 Topps Mickey Mantle" or "Charizard".
query.title: Search query

requestDelaySecs.description: Pause between PSA requests to stay inside its rate limits.
requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between requests (seconds)

setUrls.description: PSA population set links, for example https://www.psacard.com/pop/baseball-cards/1952/topps/49722. Used by setPopulation and as the set context for cardPopulation.
setUrls.title: Population set URLs

specNumbers.description: PSA spec IDs to pick out of the supplied set (mode=cardPopulation). Also accepts comma-separated values.
specNumbers.title: Spec numbers

subjectContains.description: Keep only cards whose player, character or subject contains this text.
subjectContains.title: Subject contains

varietyContains.description: Keep only cards whose variety, parallel or pedigree contains this text.
varietyContains.title: Variety contains

title: PSA Card Population Lookup Input
